answer: Put signed speech therapy assistant certification with therapy council attestation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The quill sits in the mechanism itself, the reef sits in the price of faking it, and the nadir sits in the record no template can forge. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
